data.name: Naqit
data.gender_notes: Naqit is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘n-q-t’ which means ‘to extract, remove’. This name is often used for those who are believed to have the ability to extract or remove hardships and difficulties from others’ lives. The name Naqit carries the meaning “Extractor, Remover” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naqit usually hope their child will grow to embody extractor, remover and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of spiritual significance, representing the removal of spiritual hardships and the granting of blessings.
data.etymology: Naqit belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Extractor, Remover.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naqit total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نَقِط
in_arabic.meaning: المُسمى بالأسم الذي يعني القَطر أو الماء الالِي
